title: Heretic (shareware)
subtitle: Raven Software, 1994 · episode one from id's 1.2 shareware archive, served as published and unpacked in the page; Raven's source, GPL since 2008, built with its own MAKEFILE

needsData.hint: htic_v12.zip as id published it (idgames, idstuff/heretic/): DEICE.EXE and HTIC_V12.1, .2, joined and unpacked in the page

safepointsNote: These games get their TIME from an interrupt and wait for it inside a loop of their own C -- Heretic's TryRunTics spins on `ticcount`, which only the ISR writes. A safepoint is the only place this runtime can reach into such a loop, so without them the game waits for ever and looks exactly like a hang.
_archive: The shareware licence (LICENSE.DOC, section 3) allows electronic distribution of the archive, royalty free and compressed: the data root holds the archive and the page unpacks it (web/unpack.js).
